interpretation_boundary.categorical_statistic: Total variation distance between speech/noise category distributions; no category is promoted to a rule.
interpretation_boundary.numeric_statistic: Univariate ROC-AUC only. separability_auc=max(AUC,1-AUC) is orientation-free and does not select a threshold or feature.
interpretation_boundary.population: Only frames in the existing upstream-high/local-low disagreement state are profiled.
interpretation_boundary.temporal_context: Current plus up to two previous frames only; no future information and no learned weights.
